EdgeRef.description:
Persistent edge reference.

``between``: edges shared by faces named ``faces[0]`` and ``faces[1]``.
``of_face``: every edge bounding the named face.
``all``: every edge of the body.
``nearest``: geometric fallback (fragile; flagged with a warning).
``hint`` disambiguates ``between`` when several edges match, and is used as
a fallback when the named faces no longer exist.
EdgeRef.title: EdgeRef

ItemIn.description: Create a catalog record. Provenance is mandatory for externally sourced classes.

MateRef.description:
Geometry on an instance used by a mate, expressed in the part frame.

kind=face: a named face (planar -> plane; cylindrical/conical -> axis).
kind=edge: a persistent edge reference (line -> axis; circle -> axis + centre).
kind=origin: the part origin / axes (``axis`` X|Y|Z, ``plane`` XY|XZ|YZ).
MateRef.title: MateRef
